changes: Notes expanded: the colophon names no era; NS comes from the Newari script and the catalogue, and fits Jitāmitra Malla's reign

notes: The colophon gives only 'saṃvat 806' with no era name. NS is assumed from the Newari script and the catalogue field, and NS 806 (c. 1686 CE) falls within the reign of Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur (c. NS 793–816). The quoted colophon does not mention the king (Jitāmitra Malla) or the place (Bhaktapur) given in the catalogue fields, so neither is recorded here. These details may come from elsewhere in the manuscript.
